measurement_note: The whole-pass C: free-space delta is the measured net outcome. Docker-reported logical cache reclamation, virtual-disk allocation reduction and diagnostic file allocation are different overlapping measurements and must not be added together. Other filesystem activity can affect the net volume measurement; the difference is not attributed to a specific cause.

verification.startup_recovery: Docker hit stale Windows AF_UNIX endpoint errors during restart. The two socket-only parent folders were renamed to retained backups while Docker was stopped, then normal startup succeeded. No factory reset, settings changes, data deletion or global WSL shutdown.
